records.limitations: Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: Completion %
records.source_label: nflverse weekly player stats (official box score)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 attempts; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Official completions per official pass attempt.
records.interpretation: Raw accuracy, not adjusted for how difficult the throws were.
records.limitations: Rewards short, easy throws; read it beside CPOE and intended air yards. Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: Completion % over expected
records.source_label: nflverse play-by-play (nflfastR)
records.formula: sum(cpoe) / attempts carrying a cpoe value (percentage points)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 attempts with a completion probability; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Completion percentage over expected (CPOE): his completions minus the completion probability nflfastR's model gave each attempt, in percentage points, pooled over every attempt that has a probability (throwaways and spikes have none).
records.interpretation: Positive means he completed more than the throws' difficulty predicts.
records.limitations: nflfastR's completion model, not Next Gen Stats'. Pooled over attempts, not the average of weekly values (which differ by up to 34 points). Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: Yards per attempt
records.source_label: nflverse weekly player stats (official box score)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 attempts; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Official passing yards per official pass attempt (sacks excluded).
records.interpretation: Yardage gained per throw.
records.limitations: Sacks are not attempts here; see sack rate. Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: Intended air yards per attempt
records.source_label: nflverse weekly player stats (official box score)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 attempts; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: How far downfield his passes travel on average, completed or not: official passing air yards per attempt.
records.interpretation: A style reading, not a quality: deeper throws complete less often and gain more when they do.
records.limitations: Includes incomplete passes and throwaways (official air yards).

records.label: Time to throw
records.source_label: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (season summary)
records.formula: Next Gen Stats season summary: average seconds from snap to throw
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks whose Next Gen Stats season summary matches their official volume through the cutoff (Next Gen Stats' own qualification is the minimum). A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Average time from the snap to the throw on his pass attempts (sacks excluded), from the Next Gen Stats regular-season summary.
records.interpretation: A style reading: a quick release and a long one each have costs. Neither is better.
records.limitations: Only for passers Next Gen Stats qualifies, and only when its season summary matches his official attempts through the cutoff.

records.label: Dropback success rate
records.source_label: nflverse play-by-play (nflfastR)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 dropbacks; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Share of his dropbacks (pass attempts and sacks, as play-by-play flags them) with positive expected points added. EPA > 0, not a down-and-distance rule.
records.interpretation: How consistently his dropbacks helped, regardless of size.
records.limitations: Same plays as EPA per dropback; success uses each play's own EPA. Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: EPA per dropback
records.source_label: nflverse weekly player stats (official box score)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 dropbacks; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Expected points added per dropback: nflverse's passing EPA (which credits the quarterback up to a receiver's fumble) over pass attempts plus sacks. Scrambles are not included. The same definition as the card's in-season usage reading.
records.interpretation: How much each dropback moved his team's expected score.
records.limitations: Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: Sack rate
records.source_label: nflverse weekly player stats (official box score)
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among quarterbacks with at least 50 dropbacks; below that the value prints unranked with its sample. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: Sacks taken per dropback (pass attempts plus sacks).
records.interpretation: Lower is better. Blocking, play design and the quarterback all share it.
records.limitations: Not a measure of the quarterback alone. Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

records.label: Interception rate

records.definition: Interceptions thrown per pass attempt.
records.interpretation: Lower is better.
records.limitations: Interceptions are rare: in 2023-2025 a weeks 1-5 interception rate did not anticipate the rest of the season at all (EDA 2026-10-14).

records.label: Designed rushes
records.source_label: nflverse play-by-play (nflfastR)
records.formula: his carries with qb_scramble = 0, kneels and two-point tries excluded
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among every one of the quarterbacks who has appeared this season, zeros included. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.

records.interpretation: How often the offence calls his number as a runner.
records.limitations: Includes sneaks and option keepers; a broken pass play that nflverse does not flag as a scramble would count here.

records.label: Share of team carries
records.source_label: nflverse weekly player stats (official box score)
records.formula: all his carries / all his team's official carries in his games
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among running backs with at least 2 games and a team total above zero in them; with fewer games the value prints unranked. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: His share of all his team's official carries in the games he played — every position, quarterback scrambles and kneel-downs included (the usage layer's definition). Pooled over the games he played: his total divided by his team's total in those games, keyed by the club he played for that week.
records.interpretation: How much of his team's running he gets when he plays.
records.limitations: Kneel-downs and quarterback runs sit in the denominator; leaving kneels out moved the 2026 week-5 share by a median 0.3 points (max 4.5).

records.label: Offensive snap share
records.source_label: nflverse snap counts (Pro Football Reference)
records.formula: all his offensive snaps / all his team's offensive snaps in his games
records.denominator_label: team offensive snaps in his games
records.cohort_rule: Ranked among running backs with at least 2 games and a team total above zero in them; with fewer games the value prints unranked. A cohort smaller than 5 ranks no one.
records.definition: His share of his team's offensive snaps in the games he played, pooled over snaps. Team snaps are taken from the player on the field for the most snaps.
records.interpretation: How much of the game he is on the field for.
records.limitations: Snaps are not routes or touches. A game the snap file has no row for him in is left out of both sides. Differs from the usage rails' per-game average.

records.interpretation: How much each carry moved his team's expected score.
